## Findings
- claim-1: With recorded shape \([0,1]\), let \(M_4=D_4=0_{0\times1}\), \(U_4=I_0\in\mathbb Z^{0\times0}\), and \(V_4=[1]\in\mathbb Z^{1\times1}\). Then \[ U_4M_4V_4=I_0\,0_{0\times1}\,[1]=0_{0\times1}=D_4. \] The dimensions are \((0\times0)(0\times1)(1\times1)=0\times1\). Moreover \(\det(I_0)=1\) (empty determinant) and \(\det([1])=1\), so both \(U_4\) and \(V_4\) are unimodular; \(V_4^{-1}=[1]\). Thus the required degree-\(4\) explicit witness is established.
